summary: Letter from San Bernardino County Superintendent of Schools urges the FCC to keep the E‑Rate program intact, emphasizing its critical role in providing reliable broadband for special‑education students and for underserved rural communities. The commenter urges the FCC to keep the E‑Rate program fully funded and to postpone any child‑safety or screen‑time rules to state and local authorities.
